titulo_es: The house I bought: relative prayers with «que»

com quem.consejo: To talk about a person with whom something happens.

de quem.consejo: To talk about a person you're talking about.

aquilo que.consejo: To talk about something that was said or done.

que.consejo: Join two sentences to point to a name.

texto: The **que** pronoun (which) serves to link two sentences and point to a name: **A casa que comprei é grande** (the house I bought is large). It is the relative most used in Portuguese, as in Spanish.
It is used no matter if the name is masculine, feminine, singular or plural: **o jardim que tens**, **as casas que vês**.
If the relative phrase does not need preposition, use **que**: **Esse jardim que vês ao fundo** (that garden you see at the bottom).

filas: Esse jardim que vês ao fundo.
That garden you see in the back.

frases.pt: A casa que comprei é muito bonita.
frases.es: La casa que compré es muy bonita.
frases.en: The house I bought is very nice.

frases.pt: O jardim que tens é grande.
frases.es: El jardín que tienes es grande.
frases.en: The garden you have is big.

frases.pt: Esse jardim que vês ao fundo é o meu favorito.
frases.es: Ese jardín que ves al fondo es mi favorito.
frases.en: That garden you see in the back is my favorite.
analisis: that you see in the back

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «the house I bought»?
What word do you use to join phrases with a name without preposition?

opciones.explicacion: It's used for people with preposition.

bloques.frase: A casa que comprei é grande.

opciones.texto: The house I bought is big.
The house I bought is big.
The house I buy is big.

opciones.explicacion: That's not how it's used here.
That's not used by a name.

bloques.audio: Esse jardim que vês é grande.

opciones.texto: That garden you see is big.
That garden I bought is big.
That garden where you live is big.

bloques.frase: Esse jardim que vês ao fundo.
bloques.traduccion: That garden you see in the back.

bloques.pregunta: Write in Portuguese «the book you read»

intro: Today you will learn to join two sentences in one: «the house I bought», «the book you read».
